priorityList: Use Garrote and cast it twice to extend the Improved Garrote to its max duration on opener.
Use Kingsbane on cooldown, syncing it with Deathmark if it is ready.
Use Vanish to re-apply Garrote buffed by Improved Garrote if your initial set of DoTs are close to running out and the pack is going to live for another ~20+ seconds.
Cast Envenom with 5+ Combo Points, or with 7 Combo Points when Darkest Night is active.
Cast Fan if you are at 6 Combo Points and have the Darkest Night buff.
